$description: Closed assetRole registry. Every PageSpec media field is {assetRole, assetRef}; raw URLs never appear in a PageSpec. assetRef values must be registered below and carry the matching role (checked by semantic_validate.py). compliancePinned roles are pinned to exact generationPolicy values in extraction/verify_all.py (PINNED_POLICIES). pageSpecFacing:false roles are documented for licensing only and are not in the schema's assetRole enum. Every registered asset carries generationUse (clone-only | generation-safe | blocked-for-generation, see generationUseEnum). PageSpec `mode` 'generation' accepts only generation-safe refs (rule GENERATION_MODE_CLONE_ISOLATION); every non-generation-safe asset that is pageSpecFacing has a generation-safe placeholderFor counterpart (checked by verify_all.py). Placeholder URLs use reserved domains (.invalid) only.

policyEnum.may-generate-new: Generic decorative texture/geometry with no brand or third-party content. A generator may draw a new, original, brand-neutral equivalent.
policyEnum.must-reuse-exact: Operate's own proprietary brand asset. Only the exact registered file may be referenced, only on a property Operate owns. On any other property the renderer must substitute that property's own asset; never redraw, restyle, imitate or regenerate it.
policyEnum.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party marks, real-company media or fictional-person artwork owned by Operate or others. Only registered ids may be referenced verbatim; never generate, approximate, re-attribute or invent new instances. For other properties substitute a placeholder.
policyEnum.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: A real, live endpoint or profile (video stream, social profile) or an endpoint contract that must not point at the original's live backend. PageSpecs reference it only by registered id, never as a raw URL; a renderer for any other property must replace it with that property's own endpoint.

generationUseEnum.clone-only: Operate-owned brand, product or media asset. Valid only in mode 'clone' (a reference reconstruction of the Operate site). Rejected in mode 'generation'.
generationUseEnum.generation-safe: Placeholder or original asset with no Operate, third-party or real-person content. The only class allowed in mode 'generation'.
generationUseEnum.blocked-for-generation: Third-party trademark, real/fictional-person artwork tied to the source, live endpoint/profile or licensed font. Registered only so the clone can reference it by id; rejected in mode 'generation'.
